summary: Comprehensive testing of Dynamic Pricing Engine connection between Admin Pricing Manager and Public Pricing Page. All 9 requested features verified and working correctly. Backend API returns dynamic prices including original prices for strikethrough display. Frontend correctly calculates and displays discount percentages, savings badges, and handles missing Stripe configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionPricingPage.js correctly fetches prices dynamically from GET /api/subscription-plans API
Removed hardcoded FULL_PRICES constant - all pricing now comes from API
getFullPrice() correctly uses plan.original_price_yearly/monthly from API response
getDiscountPercent() dynamically calculates discount: Premium 50%, VIP 70%
isStripeConfigured() correctly checks stripe_price_id_yearly/monthly for payment setup status
Admin PricingManager.js includes original_price_monthly/yearly fields in edit dialog
Backend subscription_pricing.py has original_price fields in DEFAULT_PLANS and migration
GET /api/subscription-plans exposes original_price and stripe_price_id fields for public view
seed_data_creation: None - used existing subscription plans data in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic Pricing Engine fully functional. Admin changes to original_price fields in Pricing Engine are immediately reflected on public /pricing page. Current DB values: Premium yearly=$299.99 (original=$599.99, 50% OFF), VIP yearly=$599 (original=$1999.99, 70% OFF). All stripe_price_id values are null, correctly showing 'Payment setup pending' on pricing cards.

1_public_pricing_fetches_dynamically.details: GET /api/subscription-plans returns correct data, frontend fetches and displays dynamically

2_premium_plan_current_and_strikethrough.details: Premium shows $299.99/year (current) with $599.99 strikethrough (original from DB)

3_vip_plan_current_and_strikethrough_pri.details: VIP shows $599/year (current) with $1,999.99 strikethrough (original from DB)

4_discount_percentage_badges_calculated_.details: Premium: 50% OFF, VIP: 70% OFF - calculated as (1 - current/original) * 100

5_savings_badges_show_correct_amounts.details: Premium: Save $300, VIP: Save $1,400.99 - calculated as (original - current)

6_yearly_vs_monthly_toggle_dynamic_savin.details: Toggle switches between yearly and monthly prices, savings recalculate accordingly

7_payment_setup_pending_when_stripe_null.details: 'Payment setup pending' message displays when stripe_price_id is null

8_admin_can_edit_original_prices.details: Admin Pricing Engine has Original Monthly/Yearly fields in edit dialog with explanation text

9_admin_changes_reflect_on_public_page.details: Public page fetches from same API that admin edits, changes reflect immediately
